card.fires_on: Partway through the word joule (kiloj-, millij-) or a number or bracket right before an energy unit such as kJ/mol, J/g or N/m, in physics and chemistry text.

modes.label: Inside joule words
modes.description: Pieces of kilojoules, millijoules or joules as the word is being spelled out.

modes.label: Before an energy unit
modes.description: A number or opening bracket just before kJ, J or N units in values and table headers.

card.writes: It suppresses length units like cm and mm, which steers the model toward energy units rather than length units.
card.plain: It notices when an energy unit like joules or kJ is being written or is about to come, and steers away from length units.
